changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE space_marine ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, coordinates_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES coordinates(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, creation_date TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), chapter_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES chapter(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, health INT NOT NULL CHECK (health > 0), is_loyal BOOLEAN NOT NULL, achievements TEXT NOT NULL, category astartes_category NOT NULL );
